text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm out with Sakura
Bakushin O...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow Sakura Bakushin O's gaze and
see
Umamusume plushies on display as
prizes for a
claw machine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, those are the plushies my
classmates keep
talking about!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As class representative,
it's imperative to
keep up
with the latest trends in class!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm going to give that claw a
good
Bakushin and get that plushie!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Once I give it some
Bakushin energy,
it'll grab the plushie
for me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hardly believe blasting the claw with
Bakushin energy will guarantee her a
plushie... I can already
see the
outcome...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, spoken with confidence! You
sounded real
dependable there! You
strike me as a
professional!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This calls for my encouragement, in a
class
representative-like fashion of
course...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You're invincible! Let's do our best!
